conventions: Explicit original-observation DATA exercises Core's production E0, signature, E1-E4, anchor and permanent-offence predicates; it grants no live authority. The record row separately replays authenticated native execution and projects its retained G6 bindings.
generator: two independent generators: python3.11 scripts/sccp_reference/generate.py --write; cargo test -p iroha_core --lib sccp -- --ignored regenerate_forgery_evidence_v1

record.description: Authenticated native genesis and one committed successor produce a verified future claim. The retained record uses start_height, not the attacker height, and copies each original G6 binding; the projection omits chain-specific hashes.
record.label: self_contained_g6_record

rows.description: A retained ended generation is still liable exactly at its capped boundary.
rows.label: e0_inclusive_window

rows.description: One liability-clock millisecond after the cap expires E0 before pairing.
rows.label: e0_expired_window

rows.description: A valid quorum signs before the retained generation starts.
rows.label: e1_before_start

rows.description: Tenure ends before this signed future height; E1 precedes E2.
rows.label: e1_after_end

rows.description: A quorum signs a height not yet committed by the original observation.
rows.label: e2_future

rows.description: A quorum completes stray Commit votes for a competing block that never committed.
rows.label: e3_stray_commit_completion

rows.description: The original core hash carries a false X.
rows.label: e4_false_header

rows.description: Genuine X with a different D_body changes the certified outer result.
rows.label: e4_genuine_x_different_body

rows.description: The genuine block and result are never evidence.
rows.label: genuine_certificate

rows.description: A different valid exact quorum for the same genuine result is never evidence.
rows.label: genuine_other_valid_signers

rows.description: The original tip supplies its own anchor without a witness.
rows.label: anchor_tip

rows.description: The original open chunk supplies height two without a witness.
rows.label: anchor_open_chunk

rows.description: A retained completed root authenticates the original twelve-sibling witness.
rows.label: anchor_completed_chunk

rows.description: A completed chunk refuses an absent witness.
rows.label: anchor_missing_witness

rows.description: A changed sibling does not reach the retained completed root.
rows.label: anchor_wrong_path

rows.description: A witness cannot restore a pruned authoritative root.
rows.label: anchor_pruned_chunk

rows.description: A generation missing from retained state has expired.
rows.label: pruned_generation

rows.description: An inactive X makes no SCCP claim.
rows.label: inactive_x

rows.description: An ACTIVE claim differs from the original inactive result at a degraded height.
rows.label: e4_active_at_degraded_height
